name: OB1 Local HTTP
description: Skill pack that lets Claude Code (or any AI coding tool that supports skills) capture, search and browse thoughts in an Open Brain over plain HTTP, without using MCP. Calls the brain's REST core at /api on the fork's own stack.

services: REST core of the brain, at /api (deploy/compose.api-public.yaml)
tools: Claude Code (or compatible skill-aware AI tool)
